title: Keep Policy Gradient in Charge: Sibling-Guided Credit Distillation for Long-Horizon Tool-Use Agents
title_zh: 让 Policy Gradient 主导：面向长程工具使用智能体的 Sibling-Guided Credit Distillation
authors: Juan Pablo De la Cruz Weinstein
abstract_en: Long-horizon tool-use reinforcement learning can learn from outcome verification, but its trajectory-level advantage is broadcast across many reasoning, API, and answer tokens. Self-distillation promises a denser signal by reusing a policy's own rollouts or a privileged teacher. We show, however, that direct token-level self-distillation can silently destroy tool use: it rehearses teacher behavior without knowing which actions the verifier rewards, so useful skills and harmful shortcuts are amplified together. We introduce Sibling-Guided Credit Distillation (SGCD), which uses distillation for credit assignment rather than as a competing actor loss. Dynamic sampling produces mixed successful and failed sibling rollouts; an external LLM summarizes their contrast into a training-only stepwise credit reference; dense teacher/student divergence drives credit reassignment; and bounded detached credit weights reshape GRPO token advantages. The deployed student sees no external LLM, sibling evidence, or oracle. Across AppWorld and $τ^3$-airline, SGCD improves over matched GRPO comparators: AppWorld TGC $42.9 \to 45.6$ on test_normal and $24.7 \to 27.0$ on test_challenge, and $τ^3$-airline pass@1 $0.583 \to 0.602$.
abstract_zh: 本文关注长程工具使用强化学习中的信用分配问题：虽然智能体可以通过最终结果验证获得奖励，但轨迹级 advantage 会被广播到大量推理、API 调用和答案 token 上，导致训练信号稀疏且噪声大。作者指出，直接进行 token 级 self-distillation 可能破坏工具使用能力，因为它只模仿 teacher 行为，却不知道哪些动作真正被 verifier 奖励，从而同时放大有用技能与有害捷径。为此，论文提出 Sibling-Guided Credit Distillation（SGCD）：不把蒸馏作为与 policy gradient 竞争的 actor loss，而是用于辅助信用分配。SGCD 通过动态采样生成成功与失败混合的 sibling rollouts，利用外部 LLM 在训练阶段总结它们的差异并形成逐步信用参考，再用 teacher/student 的稠密 divergence 进行信用重分配，最后以有界且 detached 的 credit weights 重塑 GRPO 的 token advantages。部署时，student 不需要外部 LLM、sibling evidence 或 oracle。实验显示，在 AppWorld 与 τ^3-airline 上，SGCD 相比匹配的 GRPO baseline 稳定提升：AppWorld TGC 在 test_normal 上从 42.9 提升到 45.6，在 test_challenge 上从 24.7 提升到 27.0；τ^3-airline pass@1 从 0.583 提升到 0.602。
key_points_zh: 论文指出，长程工具使用 RL 中直接 token-level self-distillation 存在风险：模型会盲目复现 teacher 轨迹，无法区分被 verifier 奖励的关键动作与有害捷径。
提出 Sibling-Guided Credit Distillation（SGCD），核心思想是让蒸馏服务于 credit assignment，而不是作为额外 actor loss 与 policy gradient 竞争。
SGCD 使用动态采样生成成功/失败 sibling rollouts，并借助训练阶段的外部 LLM 总结对比信息，构造 stepwise credit reference。
方法通过 teacher/student divergence 产生稠密信用重分配信号，再用有界 detached credit weights 调整 GRPO 的 token-level advantages，保持 policy gradient 的主导地位。
在 AppWorld 和 τ^3-airline 上，SGCD 均优于匹配 GRPO 对照组，且推理部署阶段不依赖外部 LLM、sibling evidence 或 oracle。

llm_assessment.comment: A strong long-horizon tool-use training contribution that converts sibling rollout contrast into denser credit signals while preserving policy-gradient control.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 该工作面向长程工具使用训练，将兄弟轨迹对比转化为更密集的信用信号，具有较高价值。
